texts.wk_approvals_rule: Each named approver answers in turn, never the person who sent it. A returned document goes back to the sender.
texts.wk_assist_never: LynkAssist drafts and explains. It never decides hiring, pay, promotion, discipline or dismissal, and never scores a person.
texts.wk_assist_summary: LynkAssist can draft a summary, labelled a draft. A named manager writes and signs off the review.
texts.wk_balance: Annual leave left: {n} half days ({entitled} this year, {carried} carried over, {taken} taken).
texts.wk_billed_note: {amount} added to an invoice in LynkInv. This time is never billed again.
texts.wk_board_rule: A task is done only when the tasks it waits on are done.
texts.wk_cases_hidden: Cases are seen only by HR and the named investigator.
texts.wk_cases_rule: Every step has a deadline. A decision is always a named person's, with a right of appeal.
texts.wk_changes_rule: A change request is accepted or refused by a named person, never the one who raised it.
texts.wk_checklist_rule: Final pay figures go to LynkAcc only after notice, equipment back and access closed. Optional steps never block.
texts.wk_clash: Too many people away on {days}. This is shown, never refused.
texts.wk_correction_note: Your request went to HR as a case. You can follow it in your own account.
texts.wk_expiry_rule: The person and HR are reminded 60, 30, 7 and 0 days before. Nothing is blocked automatically.
texts.wk_files_rule: Every file lives under its record and opens only where that record's service allows. Nothing under legal hold changes or is deleted.
texts.wk_final_pay_ready: Final pay figures can go to LynkAcc.
texts.wk_final_pay_waits: Final pay figures wait for notice, equipment back and access closed.
texts.wk_guests_rule: A guest sees only the project they were invited to, and never its money.
texts.wk_leave_approved_note: Leave approved. The person is told in their language.
texts.wk_leave_declined_note: Leave declined. The person is told in their language.
texts.wk_leave_rule: Nobody answers their own request. Leave is counted in half days.
texts.wk_length: The project takes {n} days on its critical path.
texts.wk_not_own_time: Time is approved by a manager, never by the person who logged it.
texts.wk_over_balance: A request for more than the balance cannot be sent.
texts.wk_over_shown: A project over budget is shown, never blocked.
texts.wk_pay_approved: Approved by two people besides the one who proposed it.
texts.wk_pay_over_budget: Pay rises of {amount} are over the budget of {budget}, so a third person must approve.
texts.wk_pay_rule: Figures only. Payroll runs in LynkAcc, and a second person posts it. Volunteers and contractors are never on payroll.
texts.wk_payroll_draft: These figures go to LynkAcc as a draft that a second person posts.
texts.wk_people_rule: Every kind of worker has a record. Names and contact details are kept in the private vault.
texts.wk_projects_rule: Costs go to LynkAcc and billed time to LynkInv. Profit is what was invoiced less what it cost.
texts.wk_record_pay_hidden: Pay and bank details are hidden from this role.
texts.wk_record_rule: Sensitive fields are seen by the fewest roles. Health, family and union details are kept only where the law allows. The person always sees their own record.
texts.wk_request_partly_signed: Some people have signed. The next one is asked now.
texts.wk_requests_rule: Ask someone to upload a document into the right record. You can follow it: asked, received, checked.
texts.wk_reviews_rule: Colleagues' and team answers show only from 3 people, and never with names.
texts.wk_sample_note: Sample records to try the page. Your own appear here once you use the service.
texts.wk_sharing_rule: Every share link ends. A password is kept only in a scrambled form.
texts.wk_signing_rule: Each signer signs the exact version they saw. The checking code never shows who signed.
texts.wk_time_rule: Time is in whole minutes. Approved billable time is billed once through LynkInv.
texts.wk_timeline_rule: Days are counted from the project's start. Tasks on the critical path move the finish date.
texts.wk_works_everywhere: Works in any signed-in browser and in the Business app, online and offline.
